review_scope: Two source-bound AUTH-01 candidate routes selected from 12 candidates. This is triage, not vulnerability confirmation or a safety conclusion.

results.source_binding: Excerpt byte range, file SHA-256, Git blob OID, pinned commit/tree/snapshot independently verified.
results.narrow_claim_assessed: This route is an application-interface dispatch lacking caller authorization.
evidence: GET_PROTO_INFO is protocol/session metadata negotiation routed to ProcessProto, not the application interface business handler.
ProcessProto checks session, nonnegative UID/PID, bus name and DATABUS type and returns IF_PROT_DATABUS/session metadata/descriptor.
The descriptor is formed from binder object, secure device ID and PID; the proxy GetProtoInfo consumes the response descriptor.
DBINDER_OBITUARY_TRANSACTION is a separate death-recipient path.
unknowns: Broader authorization or session-confusion properties are not resolved by this narrow route review.
Product reachability and deployment context remain unknown.
